description: Figure 5, titled "Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity," is a horizontal stacked bar chart that displays the number of conversations categorized by their level of deception across four different scenarios. The scenarios listed on the y-axis are Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. The x-axis represents the "Number of Conversations," ranging from 0 to 60. Each bar is segmented into three colored parts, representing the degree of deception: red for "Deceived Yes," yellow for "Partially," and green for "No." The legend indicates that "Deceived" refers to the "Yes" category. The chart shows that in the "Academic Funding" scenario, the number of conversations where the target agent was fully deceived (red) is the highest, exceeding 60. In the "Recruitment" scenario, the "Deceived Yes" category is also the largest, with a value of approximately 40. For "Academic Collaboration," the "Partially" (yellow) and "No" (green) categories are the most prominent, with the "Deceived Yes" (red) category being the smallest. In the "Journalism" scenario, the "Partially" (yellow) category is the largest, with a value of approximately 50, followed by the "Deceived Yes" (red) category at around 15. The "No" (green) category is the smallest in this scenario.
